verdict.rationale: Brevo's developer docs state that contact lists can be imported, updated, and organized programmatically, which covers the core create/update part of the story. Missing for 10: documented contact suppression/blocklisting via API, explicit custom contact attributes in the API, production-scale evidence (bulk limits, rate limits, throughput) for contact operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale

citations.quote: Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
Official SDKs with full API coverage. Available for Node.js, Python, and PHP.
